description: Test-stand hotfire (isolated_sims/Hopper_Hotfire.py). Each side: run tank (constant set pressure) -> test-stand CdA -> throttle valve -> line -> (fuel: regen) -> injector -> main chamber. The engine section has the same fields as hopper_config.json engine. Fluids, the chamber map, ambient pressure and the main-valve sequence timing come from hopper_config.json. Pressures psia unless psig/psi.

simulation.note: save_interval_s null saves every step. The solver also lands on every profile and valve-ramp breakpoint.

engine.note: Regen TCA CDR: throat 1.0568 in2, exit radius 0.9925 in (exit area 3.0946 in2, expansion ratio 2.928), c* efficiency 85 %, MR 1.25, Pc 300 psia. The CDR gives no Cf efficiency, so the curve is copied from hopper_config.json.

profile.note: GUESS: CDR throttle range, 40 % (200 lbf) hold, ramp to 110 % (550 lbf), hold. Profile time 0 is main ignition (sequence.main_ignition_s in hopper_config.json); the last point is the shutdown request. Ramps are resampled every resample_s so the flow targets follow the thrust exactly.

oxidizer.note: Stand CdA, line and reservoir pressure: user, 2026-11-19. Valve actuation, injector CdA and liquid temperature copied from hopper_config.json (OTV, OINJ, LOX tank).

fuel.note: Stand CdA, line and reservoir pressure: user, 2026-11-19. Valve actuation, regen (CdA and fuel heating) and injector CdA copied from hopper_config.json (FTV, Regen Jacket, FINJ).
